examples.english: He said to them, 'Don't be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him!

examples.english: He said to them, 'Don't be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him!

examples.coptic: ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲁϧⲟⲕ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲛ ⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲡⲓ**ⲣⲉⲙⲛⲁⲍⲁⲣⲉⲑ** ⲉⲧⲁⲕⲓ ⲉⲧⲁⲕⲟⲛ ⲧⲉⲛⲥⲱⲟⲩⲛ ⲙⲙⲟⲕ ϫⲉⲛⲑⲟⲕ ⲛⲓⲙ ⲡⲓϩⲁⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲛⲧⲉⲫⲛⲟⲩϯ .
examples.english: saying, 'Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!'

examples.coptic: ⲁⲩⲱ ⲛⲧⲉⲣⲉⲥⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲡⲉⲧⲣⲟⲥ ⲉϥⲑⲙⲟ ⲙⲙⲟϥ ⲁⲥϭⲱϣⲧ ⲉϩⲟⲩⲛ ⲉϩⲣⲁϥ ⲉⲥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ⲛⲁϥ ϫⲉⲛⲧⲟⲕ ϩⲱⲱⲕ ⲛⲉⲕϣⲟⲟⲡ ⲙⲛⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲡ**ⲛⲁⲍⲁⲣⲏⲛⲟⲥ** .
examples.english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him, and said, 'You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!'

examples.coptic: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲉⲧⲁϥⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ϫⲉⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲡⲓ**ⲣⲉⲙⲛⲁⲍⲁⲣⲉⲑ** ⲡⲉ ⲁϥⲉⲣϩⲏⲧⲥ ⲛϫⲟⲥ ⲉϥⲱϣ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲉϥϫⲱ ⲙⲙⲟⲥ ϫⲉⲓⲏⲥⲟⲩⲥ ⲡϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲇⲁⲩⲓⲇ ⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲏⲓ .
examples.english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, 'Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!'

etym.grl_meaning: a Nazarene, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth
